background_download_hint.message: You can close this popup — the download continues in the background.

open_soundcloud_page.message: Open a SoundCloud track, playlist, Likes, or User Tracks page to download it.

track_load_failed_detail.message: Something went wrong while reading the track data.

help_intro.message: Download tracks you own or have permission to download.

help_getting_started.message: Open a track, playlist, Likes, or a user's Tracks page. Use the Download button here or the download button on the SoundCloud page.

help_collection.message: For playlists, Likes, and user tracks, choose a preset or Select to pick individual tracks. Downloads keep running if you close this popup.

help_folder.message: Use the folder button to select where files are saved. Choose Downloads to return to Chrome's normal Downloads folder.

help_format.message: Auto selects the available stream. Original is available only when the artist has enabled an original download. Source quality varies by track.

help_progress.message: The status shows progress and saved files. If a track cannot be read or saved, retry after reloading SoundCloud or choosing the folder again.

help_looper.message: On a compatible individual track, Looper lets you repeat an A–B section and export that selected range as WAV. It does not change full-track downloads.

help_support.message: Need help or want to share feedback? Use the links below.

write_review.message: Write a Chrome Web Store review
